request.title: The haunted house
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: inside a candle-lit haunted house on a misty mountain. Nate and Lyrial lie still on the dusty floorboards as pale ghosts swirl above them. Tragic, quiet, beautiful. Characters: Nate: a human warlock and pirate with long wild red hair and stubble, in a dark navy captain's coat over a loose white shirt. Lyrial: a lean half-elf bard with long brown braided hair, green eyes and light stubble, in a worn brown leather coat over an olive jacket.
